scope.what_a1_is: a controlled experimental policy: a Lift PH low-dim BC-RNN trained locally with observation normalization so that a keep/replace decision on bound statistics can later be adjudicated on an executable task
scope.what_a1_is_not: it does not satisfy the original objective of reproducing an independently discovered deployment failure; that objective stays outstanding and is not discharged by any pilot outcome
scope.pilot_question: can the execution lane acquire the dataset lawfully, train under CPU-only bounded resources with normalization actually applied, and seal a checkpoint whose statistics and replay capability are established, within measured costs?

authorization.instruction: Daniel's assignment of 21 September to this lane names the pilot and assigns acquisition and training to the execution lane
authorization.numeric_limits: not yet recorded anywhere committed at freeze time; the pilot is acceptable only if a record naming the dataset byte limit, the training CPU-second or step budget, the storage bound and the rollout prohibition is committed before the first acquisition or training command
authorization.acquisition_ownership: execution lane only; this lane makes no request and consumes the execution lane's retained packet by digest

checklist.configured_evidence: the dataset URL, bytes, sha256 and the license text or terms retained in the packet; the robosuite/MuJoCo versions the dataset's env_args declare
checklist.execution_evidence: the retained license bytes permit local research use and training; the dataset's env_args (env_name Lift, controller OSC_POSE, control_freq 20) match the locked robosuite 1.4.1 executor without conversion; a mismatch is recorded, not patched
checklist.accept: both present and consistent; otherwise unresolved

checklist.item: actual training membership and normalization population
checklist.configured_evidence: train.hdf5_filter_key, hdf5_validation_filter_key and the demo list the config selects
checklist.execution_evidence: the demo keys and per-demo frame counts the SequenceDataset iterated (retained as a list with total frames per observation key), and the statistics population equal to that membership; robomimic computes mean and population std plus 1e-3 over all frames of the iterated demos in float32 with per-trajectory merging
checklist.accept: membership listed; statistics population equals it; this lane recomputes mean and std from the retained dataset rows and compares within float32 tolerance (rtol 1e-5 on mean, 1e-4 on std after the 1e-3 offset), or marks unresolved if the rows are not retained

checklist.configured_evidence: train.hdf5_normalize_obs true in the sealed config
checklist.execution_evidence: the SequenceDataset log line 'normalizing observations', a non-null obs_normalization_stats passed to run_epoch (recorded by a harness hook that does not alter training, for example the first batch's per-key mean and std after postprocess_batch_for_training), and the same statistics saved into the checkpoint
checklist.accept: a configured flag alone is a declaration; acceptance needs a batch-level or call-level witness plus the saved statistics

checklist.item: exact optimizer workload and CPU-only execution
checklist.configured_evidence: num_epochs, epoch_every_n_steps, batch_size, seq_length, learning rate, torch thread count, device
checklist.execution_evidence: the gradient-step count actually executed, per-step wall times (min, median, max, not only the fastest), initialization and data-loading time, device cpu, no CUDA or MPS initialization in the log
checklist.accept: executed steps equal the declared budget or the shortfall is recorded; CPU only

checklist.configured_evidence: experiment.rollout.enabled false, experiment.validate as declared, render_video false
checklist.execution_evidence: no environment construction, no RolloutPolicy instantiation and no rollout log lines in the retained training log; env_meta retained for the checkpoint only
checklist.accept: no rollout of any kind; a rollout makes the pilot a development execution and must be declared as such

checklist.item: checkpoint identity, saved statistics and declared replay capability
checklist.execution_evidence: the checkpoint file bytes and sha256, ckpt_dict keys, config.train.hdf5_normalize_obs true and obs_normalization_stats non-null inside it, shape_metadata and env_metadata, and a load through policy_from_checkpoint (no rollout) that binds the statistics into RolloutPolicy
checklist.accept: identity bound and the load witnessed; replay capability is declared, not demonstrated, until a rollout is authorized

checklist.item: complete measured costs and retained failures
checklist.execution_evidence: outer wall, process CPU (user and system), disk bytes written and retained, sampled temporary peak if any, download bytes and wall, every failed or repeated command with its record id
checklist.accept: costs reported in distinct scopes and never added across nesting; failures retained; unknown costs named

rules.feasible: every checklist item accepted for that dimension
rules.infeasible: an item fails with retained evidence that cannot be corrected within the recorded limits
rules.unresolved: an item lacks execution evidence or the limits were not recorded first

cannot_conclude: task competence of the trained policy
that the original objective is satisfied
possible_conclusions.loss_and_checkpoint: a training loss, one completed epoch or a saved checkpoint establishes executability only

continuation_estimate_method: from the pilot's per-step times use the median and the maximum, add the measured initialization, data loading and checkpoint-writing times per epoch, multiply by the declared epoch budget, and report a range with the sources of uncertainty (thread contention, cache mode, memory); the fastest batch is never the basis; a pilot shorter than one full epoch cannot ground the estimate

bc_rnn.zoo_selection: on_best_rollout_success_rate true, so the zoo checkpoint was selected by rollouts; A1 must not select by rollouts that could leak into confirmation

task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.status: predeclared now; activates only after a feasible pilot, a recorded full-training authority and Daniel's decision; the 60-rollout contract stays unassigned
task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.reference_policy_qualification: the trained policy qualifies as the working deployment only if it succeeds on at least 8 of 10 development seeds 200-209 at horizon 400; these qualification rollouts are budgeted separately from the contract's sixty and are declared before they run
task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.checkpoint_selection_rule: the final epoch of the declared budget, or a predeclared epoch; never selection by rollout success on any seed that the contract uses
task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.development_versus_confirmation: seeds 200-209 develop and qualify; seeds 0-9 screen under the contract; seeds 100-109 confirm; no seed serves two roles
task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.rollout_budget_consumption: qualification 10 rollouts outside the contract; contract screening 20 per arm; confirmation 20; total ceiling 70, amended from 60 before any outcome if adopted
task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.comparator: the float32-faithful conventional workflow (version 2) extended to robomimic's normalize_obs order: float64 numpy normalization then float32 tensors; it recomputes normalized observations and policy actions itself and decides with its own rule
task_evaluation_prerequisites_predeclare.endpoint: decision quality at the equal rollout budget, then complete cost per arm with shared costs separate; cost per confirmed repair undefined without a confirmed repair

nisayon_contribution_statement: what Nisayon can add over the conventional workflow in this study: (a) a population-identity check that the candidate statistics summarize the declared demos, which the ordinary workflow does not perform; (b) the dtype-faithful effective-map comparison with witness rows and the four-level distinction (numeric map, executed action, task outcome, confirmed repair) kept apart in the record; (c) automatic retention of failures and costs. Neither arm withholds evidence from the other; both read the same packet. If both make the same valid decisions at comparable cost the result is parity, and a constructed success is a case-level result only
non_authorities: a configured flag without an execution witness
a saved checkpoint without its statistics
an estimate extrapolated from the fastest batch
a rollout success rate on any seed the contract uses
